correctness.rationale: The exact 100-tetrahedron data reconstruct f=(16,116,200,100). A fixed 100-by-100 facial-relation minor has determinant -4, while a primitive integral cocycle annihilates every relation, so the relation rank is exactly 100. Mod-two rank is 98; Smith determinantal-divisor reasoning therefore forces H1=Z+(Z/2)^2. Exact quotient coordinates then classify all 307 nonfacial triangular cliques: none is zero, 157 are nonzero order-two classes with counts 55,53,49, and 150 have free coordinate plus or minus one with unoriented torsion-lift counts 38,38,37,37.

value.rationale: The mixed group H1=Z+(Z/2)^2 makes the first possible simple-loop layer structurally informative: all 307 empty triangles are essential, every nonzero torsion class already appears at the minimum length, and all four torsion decorations of a primitive free direction also appear with nearly balanced multiplicities.
